title: Dealmakers Podcast Ep 13 feat Zack Toyota
description:
Acquiring SaaS (software as a service) Companies!

Sara and Daniel interview Dealmaker, Acquirer and CEO of SelfDisrpt, Zack Toyota!

This isn't some idealistic success story, and Zack isn't some ivy league dealmaker. He's scrappy, ambitious, and does what needs to be done to succeed. 

Still in the trenches, building his startup, Zack shares what it takes to acquire SaaS companies, how to build and lead teams, and leveraging LinkedIn! Zack is a real LinkedIn OG.
